title: Native Dameng control database selection
description: The complete database mapping for the native serving selection. This replaces the PostgreSQL/MySQL database mapping; it is not merged with legacy connection or migration settings. Code-only integration pending the real complete central catalog and native build/target validation.

runtime_configuration_file.description: Required canonical absolute protected existing restricted-runtime connector JSON reference. No literal credential, owner identity or automatic grant. The connector owns socket, artifact/password references, TLS/IPC admission and all pool/operation/cleanup budgets.

schema_configuration_file.description: Required different canonical absolute protected schema policy JSON reference; exact schema/runtime-principal binding and runtime metadata/readback budgets. Does not authorize migration or load owner credentials.

readiness_seconds.description: Periodic native runtime readiness interval in seconds after each completed audit. Each audit has the existing runtime.http.request_seconds deadline; startup uses runtime.http.startup_seconds. A failure cancels the lifecycle; workers join before owner release. Explicit native env-file overrides valid YAML, ambient environment ignored, restart required.
